using Makie

function makeplot(x, y)
    fig = Figure(size=(720, 480))
    
    # Create two vertically stacked axes
    ax1 = Axis(fig[1, 1])
    ax2 = Axis(fig[2, 1])
    
    # Plot y vs x as lines on ax1
    ax1.plot!(x, y)
    
    # Plot abs(y) vs x as scatter on ax2
    ax2.scatter!(x, abs.(y))
    
    # Link x-axes
    linkxaxes!(ax1, ax2)
    
    # Set labels and title
    fig.title = "Signal"
    ax1.ylabel = "Amplitude"
    ax2.xlabel = "Time (s)"
    ax2.ylabel = "Magnitude"
    
    return fig, ax1, ax2
end
